If you follow this blog (or the now-very-occasional postings on Blue Sky or Mathstodon), you might have noticed the near-silence. For indeed I have had almost nothing to say about logical matters recently.

Rather, I am currently over three weeks into a stay in Addenbrooke’s hospital — having four-hourly intravenous antibiotics. Why so? — because by ill luck there is an infection on the artificial heart valve which I received a bit over two years ago. And that valve, it turns out, will have to be replaced in Papworth hospital next door this week.

I am being very well looked after in Addenbrooke’s by the kindest of nurses and by kind and confidence-inspiring doctors. And Papworth is truly world-class. The National Health Service at its best is a marvel! (Apart from the food perhaps ...). 

I hope to be back online after! So wish me good fortune ...
